verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a terminal emulator, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server that agents could use to drive terminal sessions is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no MCP server. The Python API and AppleScript support are developer building blocks an agent integration could be built on, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
